title: 删除传播与物理回收（tombstone + GC）
scope: Immediate tombstone filtering on read/recall plus reference-counted blob GC, unit-level; authority-mode command boundary repaired

tombstone_on_read: VikingFS._ensure_not_tombstoned(uri, ctx) refuses reads of a tombstoned source or any ancestor directory with NotFoundError before physical cleanup runs
read_file / read / glob paths call the guard, so recall and read-back stop returning deleted content immediately
VikingFS._tombstone_uri writes the tombstone before touching storage so a concurrent read cannot observe the source between fence and delete
remote glob excludes tombstoned URIs before the remote page is fetched (must_not DSL), not after
deletion_propagation: DeletionService._tombstone_scope marks every published source in scope (account, optionally user-scoped) as deleted first
DeletionService._collect_garbage then plans and reclaims reference-counted blobs
physical_gc: PublicationStore.plan_gc marks reclaimable blobs: retired generations and failed/orphan attempts, bounded by grace_seconds
PublicationStore.reclaim releases blobs whose references and retention window are satisfied; caller-supplied delete callback performs the physical rm
authority_boundary: AuthorityRepository previously proxied only the COMMANDS tuple, which omitted the tombstone surface
Added tombstone, clear_tombstone, tombstones, is_tombstoned, sources to COMMANDS so authority-mode workers reach the same repository commands
reclaim is NOT exposed over the socket: its delete callback cannot cross the frame boundary; GC physical deletion stays authority-local by design

verification.regression_note: Before the COMMANDS fix, 6 authority_wiki_catalog + 1 registry_authority tests failed with AttributeError: 'AuthorityRepository' object has no attribute 'is_tombstoned' at viking_fs/_ops.py:152

TC-3.4: test_tombstoned_source_is_refused_on_read: tombstoned source raises NotFoundError before physical delete
test_tombstone_scope_marks_published_sources: DeletionService._tombstone_scope marks all in-scope published sources
test_glob_excludes_tombstoned_uri: remote glob drops tombstoned URIs before paging

NOT_RUN: Real multi-process authority worker + socket deletion round-trip (only in-process repository and command-proxy assertions)
Physical blob GC against a real remote AGFS object store (local disk fixture only)
Wiki-reference protection under concurrent publish during deletion (only sequential unit coverage)
Full F3 / M2 gate acceptance; feature_acceptance remains NOT_RUN
